'''Jahn Tanner''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was married to [[Lania Tanner|Lania]] and the pair had a son, [[Shan Tanner|Shan]]. They lived on the [[Tanner Ranch]] in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]]. Tanner was a solidly built man with a neatly trimmed beard and piercing eyes. He wore a tan tunic and leggings favored by moisture farmers on Tatooine. Tanner, his family, and their farmhands were forced to relocate to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] in the face of a marauding force of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
